text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
At long last, the witch had found her way
to the world outside.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere she looked, she saw sights she
had never seen before,
sights filled with
wonder.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I could use my magic in this beautiful
world, how joyous it would be!
Her heart
leapt with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She told the people of the world outside,
"I'll use my magic to make
your wishes
come true."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But when she began to cast a spell, the
people all ran away from her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The people of the world outside saw magic
as a terrifying force.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They feared that magic might change the
way of the world, the one
they knew so
well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch said to them, "I want to use my
magic to make everyone
happy."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To prove she meant it, she used magic to
fly up into the sky. "See?
With this, you
can go wherever you like."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But the people only grew more afraid, and
began to shun the witch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now she was all alone in the world
outside.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Why do I have these powers?" she
wondered once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Onstage for her winning concert following
the Kikuka Sho, Rice
Shower's reception is
less than stellar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd greets her with harsh stares and
harsher words for denying
Mihono
Bourbon's Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I came here to watch Mihono Bourbon win!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Man, I wanted to see Mihono Bourbon at
center stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not a single voice can be heard praising
today's victor.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What are they... But Rice won...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Screw it, Imma shut 'em up myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, you will not. Just leave it be. Many
were eager to see Bourbon
achieve the
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But c'mon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I've a much better idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Rice! You ran spectacularly today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As boos echo across the stadium,
McQueen sends a wholehearted
cheer to
the stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If no one else wants to sing Rice Shower's
praises, then it's up to us to
do so, as her
teammates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If no one else wants to sing Rice Shower's
praises, then it's up to us to
do so, as her
teammates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I let loose a cheer of my own,
a balloon
floats up into the air, with
a banner
drooping down from it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's the deal with that?! It says
"Congrats on the Triple
Crown"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Someone must've let go of it by mistake.
But the damage is already
done.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up on stage, Rice's voice shrinks to a
quivering whine. I've never
been to a
winning concert that felt so long.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Aw, don't look so sad!
You finally got your
big win!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Aw, don't look so sad!
You finally got your
big win!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Let's have Trainer take us to
the amusement park again!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the actual famous one this time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, guys.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I'm kinda tired. I think I'll just go
home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She walks out of the room, with her head
hanging low.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like it really got to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeating the undefeated Mihono
Bourbon was a big
achievement—but one
that fans couldn't accept.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I knew there'd be some backlash, but not
this much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
One can hardly blame her. To work so
hard, only to be rewarded like
that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, she must find a way to
overcome this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Such is the duty of a victor... of one who
runs with the hopes of so
many on her
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The duty of one who runs with the hopes
of many on her shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the moment, I'm not sure if I fully
understand what she means.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A full second behind McQueen. Not in the
groove today either, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen hasn't made a full recovery yet,
but she's starting to train
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even with the advantage, though, Rice is
struggling to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Meh, we could all do better. McQueen's
scrambling to rein in her
cravings now that
she's running again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Am not! Could you not make things up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A third consecutive win in the Tenno
Sho is
on the line for me. I've
much training to
make up for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rice,
let's give it another go. In my current
state, you ought to be
able to pass me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I'll try my best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They run a few more laps, but she's never
able to overtake McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later in the day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, if I may.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen pays a surprise late-night
visit to
my office, her face more
stern than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've a favor to ask you with
regards to
the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression tells me this is going
to be serious. And with dead
silence replacing
the room's usual cheer, I start to feel
almost nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho that my third win
depends on...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'd like you to let Rice race in it too.
